decisionState.selectedIdField: Shared selectedLaunchId UUID from the national source; all six regional destinations verify the exact loaded selected ID before reporting restored.
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Existing cached launch schedule, regional candidate/policy and NWS evidence, asynchronously verified KSC mission event; no additional providers, storage or direct public-visitor LL2 calls.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Expired, missing or conflicting mission IDs are explicitly unavailable, not silently replaced. Returned regional selection is treated as a NEW mission; stale or absent source, launch holds and closed/restricted ranges do not imply safe admission or launch GO.
